decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that extends the firm’s established automation offer, the collaborative robot loading system should be kept because uncertainty is still high after only one year and the cost of continuing to test and sell it is likely modest relative to its strategic fit.

The dual-table loading system should be kept because it builds directly on the firm’s core machining and loading capabilities, and after just its launch year there is too little evidence to justify abandonment of an option with likely low continuation costs.

Although more distant from the established offer, the industrial dispensing machine should be kept because the firm is investing and expanding, the product received a visible positive quality signal through the 2024 Red Dot award, and one year is too early to conclude that its value will not materialize.
